info.title: CyberMeters Platform API
info.description: REST API for the CyberMeters external security posture platform (email protection, brand protection, attack surface, certificates & trust). Contract-level specification derived from workers/scan-api/src/index.js. Covers every route family; request/response bodies are fully schematised where the shape is stable and described otherwise. Not versioned in the path yet (all routes under /api); a /v1 alias is a planned sprint item.

get.description: Family of RBAC-read GET endpoints sharing this workspace path prefix: posture, summary, health, usage, business-risk, supply-chain, vendors, vendor-relationships, certificates, assets, admin-surfaces, cloud-assets, saas-exposure, third-party-assets, identity-assets, scorecard, executive-dashboard, cyber-essentials-readiness, activity, audit-events, brand, brand-monitoring, storage, subscription, billing. Each returns a workspace-scoped JSON payload; management sub-resources (alerts, alert-channels, notification-preferences, retention, report-retention, report-schedules, scheduled-reports, delete-request) additionally accept POST/PUT/DELETE gated by the RBAC matrix.

post.description: Authenticated by a per-workspace+domain upload token in the Authorization: Bearer header (or X-CM-Ingest-Token). Body is raw XML or { xml }.

get.description: Reverse-chronological, enriched, filterable feed of asset / DNS / email / certificate / exposure change events. Consumed by the Exposure Timeline UI and the weekly digest.

bearerAuth.description: User session token or API token (cm_...) in the Authorization header. There is no cookie auth (so CSRF is not applicable).

Error.description: Customer-safe error envelope. Every error carries a machine `code` (snake_case), a human-readable `message`, and the `error` field (machine code or human string). Raw stack traces / internal detail are never returned.

message.description: Customer-safe human-readable sentence. Present on every error; safe to show a user verbatim.

token.description: Bearer session token (send in the Authorization header).

Pagination.description: Consistent pagination descriptor returned alongside a list endpoint's named array. `has_more` is exact when `total` is present, otherwise a full-page heuristic (count === limit).

total.description: Total matching items, when cheaply known.

ExposureEvent.description: A single exposure-change event, enriched server-side with a category and a short human title. The stored description carries the before/after detail.

Conflict.description: State conflict (e.g. change already in progress)

RateLimited.description: Rate limit exceeded. A coarse per-IP guard (reads 300 / writes 60 per 5 min) plus stricter per-route limits apply.
